meta.name: triage-alert
meta.description: Triage a security alert or case. Use when given an ALERT_ID or CASE_ID to assess if it's a real threat. Enriches IOCs, searches SIEM for context, and determines if the alert should be closed (false positive) or escalated for investigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断安全告警是否为真实威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要处理大量安全告警并决定是否升级
copy.tagline_en: Determine if a security alert is a real threat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to triage security alerts and decide on escalation

howto.what: 当你提供告警ID或案件ID后，Claude会自动执行分诊流程：获取告警详情、搜索SIEM、丰富威胁情报，最终判断它是真实威胁（升级）还是误报（关闭），并输出证据摘要和后续步骤。
howto.when: 当你给出 ALERT_ID 或 CASE_ID 时触发。

say.text: 帮我判断这个案件CASE-123是否为误报。
say.note: Claude会执行完整评估并给出结论。

say.text: 对最近的告警执行分诊。
say.note: 需要提供具体ID才能开始。

howto.what_en: When you provide an alert ID or case ID, Claude automatically performs a triage workflow: gathers alert details, searches SIEM, enriches threat intelligence, then determines if it's a true threat (escalate) or false positive (close), outputting evidence summary and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an ALERT_ID or CASE_ID.

say_en.text: Assess if case CASE-123 is a false positive.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates and gives a classification.

say_en.text: Perform triage on the latest alert.
say_en.note: You must supply a specific ID to proceed.
